title: Child in Tears After Mom Crashes With No Car Seat or License
description:
On July 8th, 2024. Police responded to a car accident in which a mom with no license brutally rear-ended another car with her child inside. When officers tried to get her name, she refused. She also declined to give out her child's name.  This is the body-cam footage of the events that followed.
